original_card.question: Does one explicit extension of the connector alphabet offer a favorable completed budget?
methods: Construct and charge a legal extra operation on a minimal instance.
Prove a target-specific bound after adding one specified operation family.
original_card.acceptance_gate: State which fixed-alphabet premise changes and charge its implementation; do not declare it free. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Reproduce the 945-pairing control, then read Exact interface to list the allowed calls.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Add exactly one legally priced operation and test a tiny dirty-input instance before enumerating larger cases.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A new legal connector operation could change recursive interface cost; a larger census in the same alphabet is a separate side result.
allowed_variations: Choose one additional operation and a small source count for its first counterexample.
scope_change_triggers: Keeping the alphabet and only increasing the source count; record this as a changed assignment.
Extending a source-count census without naming a supplier/interface decision it could change; audit #2973 pruning concerns before relying on the affected predecessor exclusions.

actual_scope: Decide the shortest unsigned word for the depth-four dirty chain connector z_l += B_l z_{l-1} (l = 1..4, z_0 = x immutable, z_1..z_3 and y = z_4 dirty) over characteristic m, answering open question 1 of PR #4249 for 6 <= m <= 32: the per-call floor 4m is attained for every nonzero residue c, by explicit witness words.
scope_change_reason: The card asks about one extension of the connector alphabet. This package keeps the unsigned complete-call alphabet and lengthens the one-source chain by one more call, continuing the depth-three side question of PR #4249, whose open question 1 asks for the depth-four minimum. It does not extend a source-count census or claim a supplier improvement.
bottleneck_link: A recursive boundary that routes through three dirty intermediates pays this call count. PR #4249 found a premium over the per-call floor for m <= 5 (12, 18, 20, 25 calls); this package shows the premium disappears for 6 <= m <= 32. Side result: no consumer, paid profile or kappa change is supplied.
stop_rule: Stop after explicit witnesses for every (m, c) in a bounded range with literal dirty replay and source-bound publication checks. A uniform all-m construction was attempted for part of the session and not found; no all-m theorem is claimed.
evidence: witnesses.json lists one word with exactly m copies of each call for each of the 523 pairs (m, c), 6 <= m <= 32, 1 <= c < m. verify.py checks each word by interval subword counts, by an independent UT5(Z/m) matrix product and by two literal replays with dirty registers and random 2x2 maps, plus rejection controls, and prints a receipt with package and input SHA-256 values. The 4m floor is Lemma 1 in README.md.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

open_questions.question: Is the depth-four minimum exactly 4m for every m >= 6?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It would make the depth-four premium a small-characteristic effect, m <= 5 only, matching the depth-three law of PR #4249 where only three exceptions exist.
open_questions.first_step: Use the three-interleaving form of README Lemma 2. Find a parametric family of the sequences x, y, z for odd m and for even m, and test it against the 523 witnesses here.
open_questions.blocked_by: The structured families tried here (single interior blocks, x_j = j - 1, z_l = l - 1) either collapse c to 0 or exist only when m has a nontrivial cube root of unity.

open_questions.question: Does the per-call floor km hold at depth k >= 5 for all large m, and from which m on?
open_questions.why_it_matters: This would say whether longer dirty chains pay only a small-characteristic premium.
open_questions.first_step: Run search_witnesses.py adapted to depth five for m from 6 to 12, and an exhaustive balanced-word search where m^(k(k-1)/2) states allow it.
open_questions.blocked_by: No depth-five search was run here.

open_questions.question: Can a concrete recursive caller use a depth-four chain through three dirty intermediates at a favorable complete invoice?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The call count is exact in the stated range, but admission, dispatch and routing are unpriced.
open_questions.first_step: Locate one pinned caller that composes four complete calls through dirty workspace and price all 4m calls plus its frame changes.
open_questions.blocked_by: No selected-supplier caller is bound here.
